payload.question: Does the council hold as much in reserve as its own policy says it should?
payload.label: Money set aside for emergencies against the council's own floor, 2025/26
payload.council_caveat: The council raised its own floor from £5.4m to £5.5m when it set the 2025/26 budget, after reviewing it as part of the budget process.
payload.evidence: Every council's chief finance officer has to publish a prudent minimum for the emergency reserve. Norwich's is £5.5m. The draft 2025/26 accounts show £8.249m in the General Fund working balance at 31 March 2026 — the fourth year-end running at exactly that figure.
